stem: Before releasing the medication, a student completes a 14-hour shift and asks that every hour count toward internship credit. Select all supported statements.

choices.text: In this setting, all 14 hours must be credited because the student was present.

Under these facts, the remaining work time does not override the daily internship-credit cap.
Given the described event, only hours involving controlled substances count.
